summary: Blackboard: Glaze Writer in discussion, journal, message, assignment and test boxes; Blackboard's own editor stays one click away in ⋯. Assignments write into Blackboard's box for its own Submit, or become real pages with Full writer: MLA 9, APA 7, Chicago 17, Blank or your own format, with format checks, footnotes, versions and .docx import, export and submit. Proofing and autocorrect run on your device; citations look up a DOI, ISBN or web address when you click. Tab completion and AI feedback run only when turned on in Settings → AI; tests get proofing only. Documents: every paper, spreadsheet, PDF and slide deck in one place, from the popup, Ctrl/⌘+K or Glaze's bar on Blackboard, Canvas and Moodle. Spreadsheets with more than 380 Excel functions, charts and .xlsx or .csv files; PDFs with zoom, find and fillable forms; PowerPoint decks to read and present. PDFs and decks up to 50 MB. Deleted files wait 30 days in Trash, and all of it is in Back up…. Assignments: start a document or a spreadsheet; an uploaded PDF, deck or spreadsheet opens in its viewer and is submitted as itself. Blackboard file previews open in Glaze's PDF viewer (Settings → Course pages → Previews in Glaze). Agents (off by default): AI apps on your computer can read your courses, to-dos, grades and drafts once you allow them, and ask before any change. Writer's pages follow a dark Look; Light page keeps them white. Mods: glaze.documents. Settings → AI: named providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, xAI, Mistral, Groq, DeepSeek) beside the on-device model, one model for all features or one each, and your own endpoints in Advanced; an existing endpoint moves over. Motion starts at Expressive. Updating moves Subtle to Expressive once; Off stays Off. Gallery Looks you save or use now appear wherever a Look is picked, a course's own Look included. Text pasted from Word keeps a colour only where it reads; Clear all removes papers and documents, Trash too. Blackboard: the rubric shows on a saved draft's page and after going back to an assignment; side panels open over Glaze's column; soon and today chips are right across a clock change. Blackboard: Content leaves folders and scrolling to Blackboard; search follows its links; Remember your place off cancels a pending restore. Writer: a visible caret on dark pages, no doubled spelling marks in Chrome, a page counter that follows the view, and Submit that waits out a slow save. Settings → Writer: Versions kept saves 50 and 100. The sidebar covers its card beside a scrollbar. Your buddy's page survives updates.
